claims.claim: Cipher is expanding beyond bitcoin mining into hyperscale HPC infrastructure: Q2 disclosed an option for up to 900 MW near San Antonio and project financing that fully funds Stingray through substantial completion.

risks.risk: Apollo remains an option and grid/interconnection progression is not equivalent to delivered capacity.

unknowns.unknown: Tenant economics and realized returns on the new pipeline remain unproven in the retrieved release.

claims.claim: Cipher delivered initial Black Pearl capacity in early August, two months ahead of the original schedule, and rent commenced; Barber Lake tenant beneficial use had also begun.

risks.risk: Q2 revenue was $25 million and adjusted EBITDA was negative $30 million, so execution progress has not yet translated into positive operating economics.

unknowns.unknown: Full delivery timing and stabilized margins for contracted HPC campuses remain future execution items.
